name: A Chinese painting or calligraphy on paper (ink and light colour on a bast-fibre xuan or mulberry paper, backed in its mount): the image in the paper

diffuseAlbedo.note: The reflectance a photograph of the paper's white stands for: a first value, until an old xuan paper is measured. The paper's tone as it has aged is in the photograph itself.

refractiveIndex.note: The paper's bast fibres and the size over them lie near the same index.

porosity.note: An unsized bast-fibre paper is open; no measurement was read.

wettingDepth.note: A mounted painting is the sheet on two or three layers of paper: water reaches all of it.
